face.name: 火元素
face.flavorText: 他从来不洗澡。嗯...

face.name: Fire Elemental
face.flavorText: He can never take a bath. Ewww.

face.name: 恐惧地狱火
face.text: 战吼：对所有其他角色造成1点伤害。
face.flavorText: “地狱火！”——加拉克苏斯，燃烧军团的艾瑞达之王

face.name: Dread Infernal
face.text: Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to ALL other characters.
face.flavorText: "INFERNOOOOOOOOOO!" - Jaraxxus, Eredar Lord of the Burning Legion

face.name: 列王守卫
face.text: 嘲讽，战吼：为你的英雄恢复 6点生命值。
face.flavorText: 神圣的造物从天而降...真是老掉牙的剧情！

face.name: Guardian of Kings
face.flavorText: Holy beings from the beyond are so cliché!

face.name: 负伤剑圣
face.flavorText: 他说这是在一次惨烈的战斗中留下的伤疤，但我们觉得，他只是刮胡子的时候弄伤了自己。

face.name: Injured Blademaster
face.flavorText: He claims it is an old war wound, but we think he just cut himself shaving.

face.name: 精灵弓箭手
face.flavorText: 媚眼如丝，轻盈如燕，致命如箭。

face.name: Elven Archer
face.flavorText: Don't bother asking her out on a date. She'll shoot you down.

face.name: 巫医
face.flavorText: 别以为带上大坏蛋面具，再把两根筷子插在嘴里，你就是巫医了，伙计。

face.name: Voodoo Doctor
face.flavorText: Voodoo is an oft-misunderstood art. But it is art.

face.name: 烈焰小鬼
face.text: 战吼：对你的英雄造成3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 小鬼们喜欢引火上身。它们就是喜欢。

face.name: Flame Imp
face.flavorText: Imps like being on fire. They just do.

face.name: 银色保卫者
face.text: 战吼：使一个其他友方随从获得圣盾。
face.flavorText: “我没说你能够躲过火球。我是说有了这盾，你就不需要躲了。”

face.name: Argent Protector
face.flavorText: "I'm not saying you can dodge fireballs. I'm saying with this shield, you won't have to."

face.name: 日怒保卫者
face.text: 战吼：使相邻的随从获得嘲讽。
face.flavorText: 她拿着一面盾牌，但也只有这样，她才能把它给别人，然后躲在后面。

face.name: Sunfury Protector
face.flavorText: She carries a shield, but only so she can give it to someone she can stand behind.

face.name: 寒光先知
face.text: 战吼：使你的其他鱼人获得+2生命值。
face.flavorText: 寒光鱼人终年居住于无底海渊最黑暗的洞穴之中。所以，是的，你到哪儿都别想摆脱鱼人。

face.name: Coldlight Seer
face.flavorText: The Coldlight murlocs reside in the darkest pits of the Abyssal Depths. So no, there's no getting away from murlocs.

face.name: 欢快的同伴
face.text: 战吼：使一个友方随从获得+2生命值。
face.flavorText: 放心吧！水，食物，帐篷，都带好了！还有被诅咒的猴爪！

face.name: Beaming Sidekick
face.flavorText: Sure, I'll carry the water! And the food! And the tents! And the cursed monkey paw!

face.name: 受伤的托维尔人
face.text: 嘲讽。战吼：对本随从造成3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 贼来十步乃呼我！

face.name: Injured Tol'vir
face.flavorText: Me-OW!

face.name: 火羽凤凰
face.flavorText: 凤凰本非凡俗鸟，浴火重生凌云霄。

face.name: Fire Plume Phoenix
face.flavorText: This is what happens when you use a volcano as a bird bath.
